items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: What kind of a band did it with Celestine?

ctx.x: No, none of them influenced me. As I said, I didn't have anyone that I wanted to copy. I just liked music. I had no style that I wanted to copy. I just wanted my own. So therefore, no one influenced me really. I just liked music. It was a part of me, and it was my talent. And of course, as I say, I play all types. I didn't only play jazz. I play everything. So there was no one really influenced me.
What kind of a band did it with Celestine? I mean, was he a very good musician?
I think he was all right. A very likable person. He, he, what he did play, played well.
